keyHints.INVENTORY: Debited on every receipt and count surplus; credited on every issue and count shortage.
keyHints.GRNI: Credited on receipt — stock received but not yet invoiced by the supplier.
keyHints.PROJECT_ISSUE_EXPENSE: Debited when stock is issued to a project.
keyHints.COUNT_LOSS: Debited when a count finds less stock than the books.
keyHints.COUNT_GAIN: Credited when a count finds more stock than the books.
keyHints.ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE: Credited with the gross amount of every supplier invoice.
keyHints.VAT_INPUT: Debited with the VAT on supplier invoices.
keyHints.PURCHASE_PRICE_VARIANCE: Debited (or credited) when a supplier invoice price differs from the order price.
keyHints.ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE: Debited with the gross amount of every sales invoice; credited by credit notes.
keyHints.SALES_REVENUE: Credited with the net of sales invoices (a line can name its own account instead).
keyHints.VAT_OUTPUT: Credited with the VAT charged on sales invoices.
keyHints.COST_OF_GOODS_SOLD: Debited with the cost of the stock sold, at weighted-average cost.
